metrics.name: encapsulation
metrics.definition: contract / (contract + intrusive) cross-boundary edges (functional, model, unknown excluded)

metrics.name: unbalanced_edge
metrics.definition: intrusive edges with cross-module ownership and high volatility

metrics.name: blast_radius
metrics.display: 2 change-impact hub(s): internal/spot (100%, 2 deps), internal/mcp (50%, 1 deps)
metrics.definition: modules whose transitive reverse-dependencies exceed 30% of the codebase (change-impact hubs)

metrics.name: change_amplification
metrics.display: 2 volatile hub(s): internal/spot (amp 0.70: 2 deps × 19 commits), internal/mcp (amp 0.26: 1 deps × 14 commits)
metrics.definition: modules ranked by blast radius × recent churn (volatile change-impact hubs)

metrics.name: cohesion_lcom
metrics.definition: LCOM edge-density proxy: multi-document modules whose definition symbols split into >1 connected component over same-module SCIP references (fragmented = lacking cohesion). Document-scoped attribution makes single-document modules (the common Python/TS shape) unmeasurable — n/a, not a false verdict. Report-only; never gates.

metrics.name: hidden_coupling
metrics.definition: module pairs that co-change without importing each other (coupling unseen by the graph)

metrics.name: structural_weight
metrics.definition: modules whose size (LOC) is a large multiple of the codebase median (size-skew god-modules)

metrics.name: complexity
metrics.display: 3 complex function(s) (CCN>15): GetSpotSavings CCN 25 (.../spot/client.go:183), execMainCmd CCN 23 (.../spotinfo/main.go:166), resolveOnPath CCN 16 (.gitnexus/run.cjs:64)
metrics.definition: functions whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds 15 (external tool: lizard)

metrics.name: risk_hub
metrics.display: 3 risk hub(s): internal/spot [breadth 72, ×1.00, gn×2.00→144.00], internal/mcp [breadth 62, ×1.00, gn×1.45→90.18], cmd/spotinfo [breadth 21, ×1.00, gn×1.09→22.91]
metrics.definition: cross-module surface breadth × explicit config volatility × gitnexus historical impact: count of a module's symbols referenced from other modules, refined by historical change impact (churn-independent; never gates)

metrics.name: architecture_fitness
metrics.definition: fraction of architecture-enforcement signals present (arch tests, import-linter config, arch-linter in CI)

metrics.name: functional_candidates
metrics.definition: cross-module pairs with duplicated logic (clone-based); DISTINCT from hidden_coupling (co-change without static edge) — this is duplication-based

metrics.name: change_locality
metrics.display: 2 cross-module edge(s) from 3 changed file(s); forward reach 19 file(s)
metrics.definition: per-change drift: cross-module edges originating in changed files + forward graph reach from changed nodes (delta mode only; report-only, never gates)

metrics.name: instability
metrics.definition: per-module instability I=Ce/(Ca+Ce): fraction of dependencies that are outgoing; high I = depends on many, depended on by few

metrics.name: abstractness
metrics.definition: per-module abstractness A=abstract_inbound/(abstract+concrete_inbound): fraction of inbound dependency edges targeting an interface/protocol (SCIP strength hint), NOT the glob-classified strength; beyond Balanced Coupling, report-only

metrics.name: martin_distance
metrics.display: 1 modules in zone of pain/uselessness (Dms>0.5): internal/spot (Dms=1.00, A=0.00, I=0.00)
metrics.definition: distance from main sequence Dms=|A+I-1|; >0.5 = zone of pain (too concrete+stable) or uselessness (too abstract+unstable); beyond Balanced Coupling, report-only

metrics.name: propagation_cost
metrics.definition: propagation cost PC=reachable_pairs/(n*(n-1)): fraction of ordered module pairs (i,j) where j is transitively reachable from i; system + per-module; beyond Balanced Coupling, report-only

metrics.name: change_coupling
metrics.definition: change-coupled module pairs (CC≥65%%): CC≈max-file-pair-co-change/min(module commits), an approximation of CodeScene's C_AB/min(C_A,C_B) clamped to 100%% (true module C_AB needs commit→module data); beyond Balanced Coupling, report-only
